basics.name: Anthony Hernandez Flores
basics.label: Full Stack Mobile Developer
basics.summary: Full Stack Mobile Developer specializing in crafting exceptional cross-platform experiences with Flutter/Dart. I architect robust applications using Clean Architecture and BLoC/Cubit, ensuring seamless integration of complex native iOS and Android modules when required. My expertise spans the entire development lifecycle—from designing pixel-perfect UIs based on Figma handoffs to deploying scalable backend solutions via Firebase and cloud services. With a strong foundation in QA engineering and experience deploying ML chatbots (RASA), I bring a disciplined, full-stack perspective that drives high-quality delivery, whether building production apps or streamlining internal tools within Agile environments.

projects.name: Summoner Timer
projects.description: A mobile application built with Flutter that provides an external tool to track League of Legends player enemy skill cooldowns.
highlights: Follows Clean Architecture with Presentation, Domain, and Data layers
Uses BLoC for state management
Integrates with RIOT GAMES APIs for real-time data
Provides intuitive mobile interface for quick reference during matches

projects.name: Git Commit TUI
projects.description: A terminal user interface (TUI) tool written in Rust that helps generate conventional commit titles from staged git changes using AI or interactive fallback.
highlights: AI-powered commit title generation using local LLM (ollama/llama.cpp)
Interactive fallback with menus to manually select commit type, scope, and description
gitemoji support for visual commit type selection
Built with Rust/Cargo, Clap, Inquire, Reqwest, Tokio, Serde, Anyhow, Regex
